description: A single-token env-var label (DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL) must wrap inside the settings row's fixed 104px label column instead of running into the control beside it (#6271). PropertyList's settings variant puts overflow-wrap: anywhere on .settingsLabel; this pins that rule. The inline facts label has its own identical .label rule, which this settings-layout fixture does not exercise.

mutation.declaration: widgets/propertylist/propertylist.module.css .settingsLabel overflow-wrap: anywhere deleted, leaving the single-token label to run past its 104px column into the input
mutation.note: Observed red run without the declaration: the label's glyphs ran 31px past its 104px column instead of wrapping, and the label stayed one line at 19.2px against a 19.2px line height. With the declaration the label wraps to two lines inside the column and the 612px input keeps its track.
